behavior: Empty canvas opens a connected main/editor/result example using user-supplied images.
Single-image toolbar creates an independent flat editor for the selected image.
Deleting the main preserves the empty editor and its position, resetting settings to defaults.
Adding a main via the single asset picker preserves the flat editor identity and existing result connections.
Region, face, ratio and resolution changes use canvas undo history.
Generating requires a main image only; it appends the fixed supplied example at width 360 and original 1792:2400 ratio. No AI request or charge.
Navigation, selection, dragging, arrangement and connection layers use shared canvas geometry.
Both themes use existing semantic tokens; interactions use 200ms ease-out and reduced-motion handling.
validation: Implementation only; no browser, build or tests run per user instruction.
